slides.title: Executive Summary
slides.headline: Overall reserves increased GBP 4m to GBP 610m
slides.plain_text:
Executive Summary
Overall reserves increased GBP 4m to GBP 610m
Total reserve: GBP 610m
Quarterly movement: +GBP 4m
Ultimate claims: GBP 3,761.2m
The principal increases were Property +GBP 3m and Casualty +GBP 2m.
Marine released GBP 2m following favourable development.
No projection-method selections changed this quarter.
Recent Casualty accident years remain a focus; Property large loss development continues while Marine shows favourable movement.

slides.title: Reserving Class Commentary
slides.headline: Principal class movements and drivers
slides.plain_text:
Reserving Class Commentary
Principal class movements and drivers
Property: strengthened GBP 3m. Large loss development from the September windstorm events is the main driver.
Casualty: strengthened GBP 2m. Recent accident years remain the principal focus; strengthening reflects sustained adverse emergence.
Marine: released GBP 2m. Favourable development has supported a measured release.
Motor: strengthened GBP 1m. Frequency and severity trends remain within expectation.

slides.title: Key Uncertainties and Areas of Focus
slides.headline: Qualitative areas of focus from the actuarial review
slides.plain_text:
Key Uncertainties and Areas of Focus
Qualitative areas of focus from the actuarial review
Recent Casualty accident years remain the dominant reserve uncertainty at the year end.
Property large loss development from the September events is maturing but not yet fully settled; the management loading has been retained.
Marine has shown favourable development; the release has been taken cautiously given historic volatility.

slides.title: Conclusion and Next Review
slides.headline: Overall reserve conclusion and forward focus
slides.plain_text:
Conclusion and Next Review
Overall reserve conclusion and forward focus
The year-end position reflects continued Casualty focus, maturing Property large losses and a first favourable movement in Marine.
This review has been prepared by the actuarial function for management and Board use. Selections reflect actuarial judgement applied to the data available at the valuation date; they will be reassessed at the next quarterly review.
Total reserve: GBP 610m
